Brand and Visual Style:
- Brand primary teal #0F766E, Plus Jakarta Sans, strictly light theme with clean surfaces: crisp white (#ffffff), soft light grey/mint tint background (#F5F7F8 / #f0f7f6), dark slate text (#0B1218), muted slate labels (#5C6B76), light outline/borders (#E3E9ED), soft mint tint badges (#E6F4F1 / #CCECE6).
- Strictly NO purple, violet, or dark mode. Professional B2B data-dense aesthetic matching the existing GeoLens screens (Sources & Citations, Brand Performance, Prompt Tracking, Overview). No emojis.

Global Chrome Layout:
1. Left Navigation Sidebar:
   - Header: GeoLens logo with v2.4 badge and subtext "Spatial & Search AI" or "AI Visibility Suite".
   - Primary CTA button: Teal #0F766E "+ New Analysis".
   - Navigation Categories:
     - AI ANALYSIS: Visibility Overview, Competitor Research (with badge 5), Prompt Research.
     - BRAND PERFORMANCE: Brand Performance, Perception & Sentiment, Fact-checking.
     - BOOST & MONITOR: Prompt Tracking (with badge LIVE), Sources & Citations, and Actions & Fixes (ACTIVE state with teal background/pill #E6F4F1, text #0F766E, font-semibold).
   - Bottom sidebar: Prompt Quota progress bar (28.4%, 1,420 / 5,000 queries, Manage link), Docs, Support, Settings.

2. Top Navigation Bar:
   - Project switcher: "Attio · Demo" dropdown.
   - Date selector: "Last 7 days" (selected), "Last 30 days", "90 days".
   - Engine selector: "All Models (4 Engines)" dropdown.
   - Trial status pill: "14 days left in trial" with "Upgrade" link.
   - Action buttons: "Export Report", Teal "+ New Analysis" button, notification bell, user avatar AL.

3. Main Content — "Actions & Fixes":
   - Header Breadcrumb / Title Area:
     - Title: "Actions & Fixes" with a soft mint badge "Opportunity Queue" and green live pulse dot.
     - Subtitle: "Ranked recommendations grounded in evidence (R1–R10) — prioritized optimizations to reclaim citation share and resolve AI visibility deficits."
     - Header actions: "Saved Views", "Share Queue", Teal button "Run Auto-Prioritization".

   - KPI Summary Cards (4 dense metric tiles):
     - Open Actions: "28" (+4 new this crawl, "Awaiting triage")
     - High Opportunity: "9" (Est. +18.4% citation lift, "Top priority")
     - In Progress: "6" (3 engineering, 3 editorial, "Active sprint")
     - Resolved / Completed: "42" (Last 30 days, "100% verified by LLMs")

   - Filter & Grouping Toolbar:
     - Status tabs: All (28) | New (13) | In Progress (6) | Done (42)
     - Group filters: All Groups | SITE_AUDIT (11) | OWNED_CONTENT (9) | EARNED_MEDIA (8)
     - Severity / Impact filter dropdown: High (Score ≥ 80), Medium, Low
     - Search input: "Search actions by keyword, domain, or root cause..."
     - Batch bar: "Bulk Actions: Assign, Mark Done, Export CSV"

   - Main Content Grid (Two-column: 8 cols main queue, 4 cols sidebar intelligence):
     - Left Column (Main Queue - dense structured recommendation cards R1–R7):
       * Card R1 (High Opportunity - SITE_AUDIT):
         - Rank badge: "R1" (Teal badge) | Group: "SITE_AUDIT" (Outline tag) | Score: "94/100 Opportunity Score" (Teal filled progress bar)
         - Title: "Inject missing JSON-LD Product & Pricing Schema on /docs/pricing"
         - Root Cause & Deficit: "ChatGPT-4o and Perplexity fail to quote seat tiers because pricing tables are rendered via dynamic client-side JS without Schema.org markup."
         - Evidence Snippet: "Perplexity Pro: 'Attio enterprise pricing requires bespoke annual quote...' (Deficit detected in 34 competitor queries)."
         - Meta: Impact "+6.2% Citation Share" | Effort: "Low (1h)" | Engine Impact: "Perplexity, Google AI Overviews"
         - Actions: Primary teal button "Open Fix Blueprint", secondary "Assign", menu "...".

       * Card R2 (High Opportunity - OWNED_CONTENT):
         - Rank: "R2" | Group: "OWNED" | Score: "89/100"
         - Title: "Publish Relational Schema vs HubSpot Comparison Guide"
         - Root Cause & Deficit: "HubSpot cited in 71.0% of 'modern CRM architecture' queries; Attio cited in only 32% despite feature parity."
         - Evidence Snippet: "Google AI Overviews synthesized comparison relying solely on G2 and HubSpot blog tables."
         - Meta: Impact "+5.4% Citation Share" | Effort: "Medium (4h)" | Engine Impact: "ChatGPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro"
         - Actions: "Open Fix Blueprint", "Assign".

       * Card R3 (High Opportunity - EARNED_MEDIA):
         - Rank: "R3" | Group: "EARNED" | Score: "86/100"
         - Title: "Claim and Update G2 Product Attribute Matrix for Developer Workflows"
         - Root Cause: "G2 accounts for 34.8% of Google AI Overviews source citations. Attio missing in GraphQL benchmark filter."
         - Evidence Snippet: "G2 category grid cited 232 times across CRM queries; Attio profile missing API rating criteria."
         - Meta: Impact "+4.8% Citation Share" | Effort: "Low (2h)" | Engine Impact: "Google AI Overviews"
         - Actions: "Open Fix Blueprint", "Assign".

       * Card R4 (SITE_AUDIT - In Progress):
         - Rank: "R4" | Group: "SITE_AUDIT" | Score: "82/100" | Status: "In Progress (Dev)"
         - Title: "Resolve robots.txt blocking of PerplexityBot on /benchmarks/*"
         - Root Cause: "Recent CDN rule blocked AI user agents from reading internal benchmarks."
         - Evidence Snippet: "HTTP 403 logged for PerplexityBot; 12 prompt citations lost in last 7 days."
         - Meta: Impact "+3.9% Citation Share" | Effort: "Immediate" | Engine Impact: "Perplexity Pro"
         - Actions: "View Pull Request", "Re-crawl Test".

       * Card R5 (OWNED_CONTENT - In Progress):
         - Rank: "R5" | Group: "OWNED" | Score: "78/100" | Status: "In Progress (Editorial)"
         - Title: "Authoritative SOC2 Type II Security Documentation Page Update"
         - Root Cause: "LLMs hallucinate that SOC2 certification is pending based on outdated 2023 tech blog post."
         - Evidence Snippet: "ChatGPT-4o flagged SOC2 status as 'unverified enterprise friction' in 14 RFP prompt evaluations."
         - Meta: Impact "+3.1% Citation Share" | Effort: "Low" | Engine Impact: "ChatGPT-4o, Claude 3.5"
         - Actions: "Open Fix Blueprint", "Review Draft".

       * Card R6 (EARNED_MEDIA):
         - Rank: "R6" | Group: "EARNED" | Score: "74/100"
         - Title: "Seed Technical Proof-Points on Reddit r/sales & Hacker News Discussion"
         - Root Cause: "Reddit represents 48.9% citation frequency for raw founder recommendations. Competitor Folk dominates."
         - Evidence Snippet: "Attio mentioned without direct URL attribution in 139 developer discussions."
         - Meta: Impact "+2.8% Citation Share" | Effort: "Medium" | Engine Impact: "Google AI Overviews, Perplexity Pro"
         - Actions: "Open Fix Blueprint", "Assign".

     - Right Column (Sidebar Intelligence & Context):
       * Panel 1: "Why this matters — Algorithm Impact"
         - Detailed educational insight explaining how LLM retrieval synthesis weights citations: Structured JSON-LD schema (38%), Authoritative 3rd-party reviews (31%), Direct documentation freshness (22%), Social consensus (9%).
         - Projected Opportunity Impact: "+18.4% Aggregate Visibility Lift" if top 5 ranked actions are deployed this sprint.
         - Quick button: "Explore Projected Impact Model →"

       * Panel 2: "Grounding Index & Engine Telemetry"
         - Breakdown of which engines benefit most from current queue fixes:
           - Perplexity Pro: 8 actions (+7.8% projected)
           - Google AI Overviews: 11 actions (+6.4% projected)
           - ChatGPT-4o: 9 actions (+4.2% projected)

       * Panel 3: "Automated Verification Webhook"
         - Status: "Active (Hourly verify crawl)"
         - "When your engineering team marks an issue deployed, GeoLens initiates an isolated synthetic prompt test to confirm LLM citation recovery within 4 hours."
         - Action link: "Configure CI/CD & JIRA Webhooks"

Geospatial Analytics","styleGuidelines":"## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a high-density, analytical workspace engineered for spatial intelligence, enterprise location analysis, and competitive benchmarking. It targets enterprise strategists, data scientists, and operations executives who rely on swift pattern recognition across multi-layered geospatial datasets.

The aesthetic philosophy balances modern architectural restraint with high-functioning utilitarianism. By pairing crisp, structural neutrals with concentrated teal focal points, the interface creates an environment of calm focus and absolute precision. Every element communicates reliability, analytical rigor, and quiet confidence—deliberately avoiding decorative noise, gratuitous gradients, or dark-mode cognitive strain.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model utilizes a fluid 12-column analytical grid flanked by persistent floating control panels and interactive side inspectors. Spacing adheres to a strict 4px/8px modular cadence.

### Breakpoints & Adaptability
- **Desktop Wide (≥1440px)**: 12-column grid, fluid analytical viewport, 24px gutters, fixed-width tool rails (320px sidebar, 400px inspection pane).
- **Desktop/Laptop (1024px – 1439px)**: 12-column grid, 16px gutters, collapsible secondary drawer, map/chart area claims dominant flex-basis.
- **Tablet (768px – 1023px)**: 8-column layout, inspector panel converts into an absolute-positioned bottom sheet.
- **Mobile (<768px)**: Single-column flow with full-width horizontal-scroll cards, stacked key performance tiles, 16px outer safety margins.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy uses crisp, ambient low-blur drop shadows paired with fine boundary lines to maintain clarity across dense spatial layers. 

### Elevation Tiers
- **Tier 0 (Base Surface)**: `#F5F7F8` flat canvas, no shadow.
- **Tier 1 (Cards, Data Panels, Metrics)**: Pure `#FFFFFF`, `border: 1px solid #E3E9ED`, `box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.04), 0 1px 2px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.02)`.
- **Tier 2 (Hovered Cards, Dropdowns, Segment Popovers)**: `#FFFFFF`, `border: 1px solid #E3E9ED`, `box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -2px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.06), 0 2px 6px -1px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.03)`.
- **Tier 3 (Floating Map Controllers, Modals, Flyouts)**: `#FFFFFF`, `border: 1px solid #E3E9ED`, `box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -4px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.08), 0 4px 10px -2px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.04)`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Action**: Solid `#0F766E` background, `#FFFFFF` bold text, 8px border radius, 0 1px 2px shadow. Hover: `#115E59`. Active: `#134E4A`.
- **Secondary Action**: `#FFFFFF` background, `#0B1218` text, 1px `#E3E9ED` border. Hover: `#F0FDF4` tint, border shifts to `#0F766E`.
- **Tertiary / Utility**: Ghost button with `#5C6B76` text. Hover: `#F5F7F8` fill, `#0B1218` text.

### Cards & Analytics Panels
- Standardized with pure `#FFFFFF` background, 12px or 16px corner radius, and 1px `#E3E9ED` perimeter stroke. 
- Headers feature uppercase `#5C6B76` micro-labels (`label-md`) coupled with large `#0B1218` numeric readouts.

### Chips & Filter Pills
- **Neutral State**: `#FFFFFF` background, 1px `#E3E9ED` border, `#5C6B76` text, 6px radius.
- **Active / Selected State**: `#ECFDF5` background, `#0F766E` text, 1px `#0F766E` border.

### Inputs & Controls
- **Text Inputs**: Height 36px/40px, pure `#FFFFFF` fill, 1px `#E3E9ED` border, 8px radius, `#0B1218` value text. Focus: 1px solid `#0F766E` with 2px `#ECFDF5` outer focus ring.
- **Checkboxes & Radios**: 16px square/round with 1px `#E3E9ED` border. Checked: `#0F766E` fill with `#FFFFFF` check/dot indicator.

### Data Tables & Geospatial Lists
- Alternating row interaction: Pure `#FFFFFF` resting, transitioning to `#F0FDF4` on pointer hover.
- Row separators: 1px solid `#E3E9ED`.
- Table head: `#F5F7F8` background with uppercase `label-md` tracking in `#5C6B76`.

## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a high-density, analytical workspace engineered for spatial intelligence, enterprise location analysis, and competitive benchmarking. It targets enterprise strategists, data scientists, and operations executives who rely on swift pattern recognition across multi-layered geospatial datasets.

The aesthetic philosophy balances modern architectural restraint with high-functioning utilitarianism. By pairing crisp, structural neutrals with concentrated teal focal points, the interface creates an environment of calm focus and absolute precision. Every element communicates reliability, analytical rigor, and quiet confidence—deliberately avoiding decorative noise, gratuitous gradients, or dark-mode cognitive strain.

## Colors

The palette operates under a strict single-mode light paradigm, utilizing cool atmospheric tones to maintain visual comfort across prolonged analytical sessions. Purple and indigo spectrums are strictly excluded across all interface layers and chart series.

### Semantic & Surface Structure
- **Canvas Root**: `#F5F7F8` serves as the structural floor, giving subtle framing to elevated data panes.
- **Surface Panels**: Pure `#FFFFFF` for primary cards, sidebars, floating inspectors, and modals.
- **Surface Wash & States**: `#F0FDF4` and `#ECFDF5` provide ambient status washes, hover fills, and selection containers.
- **Dividers & Structural Borders**: `#E3E9ED` delivers a crisp, low-weight separation layer.
- **Typography & Icons**:
  - Primary Ink: `#0B1218` (high-contrast, anti-aliased legibility).
  - Muted Metadata: `#5C6B76` (secondary labels, axes, table metadata).

### Key Highlights of the Design:

1. **Global Chrome & Navigation Consistency:**
   - **Side Navigation:** GeoLens v2.4 suite branding, teal `+ New Analysis` CTA, full taxonomy across *AI Analysis*, *Brand Performance*, and *Boost & Monitor*, with **Actions & Fixes** in an active mint-washed pill state (`#E6F4F1` / `#0F766E`). Includes bottom prompt quota monitoring (`28.4%`, 1,420 / 5,000 queries) and system utility links.
   - **Top Navigation Bar:** Project switcher (`Attio · Demo`), date range selector (`Last 7 days`), model selector (`All Models (4)`), trial status (`14 days left`), `Export Report`, and primary action triggers.

2. **Actions & Fixes Opportunity Queue:**
   - **Header & Action Bar:** Clean header with the `Opportunity Queue` badge, descriptive subtitle (*Ranked recommendations grounded in evidence (R1–R10)*), and rapid controls for `Saved Views`, `Share Queue`, and `Run Auto-Prioritization`.
   - **Top KPI Cards (4 dense metric tiles):**

     - **In Progress:** `6` (3 dev, 3 editorial, active sprint)

3. **Status Filters & Group Classification:**

   - Category tags for `SITE_AUDIT`, `OWNED_CONTENT`, and `EARNED_MEDIA`, paired with impact tier filtering (`High (≥ 80)`), keyword search, and bulk workflow controls.
